subject: A focused integration resource for WordPress projects
body:
Hi AZ Web Corp team,

I saw that your WordPress work includes custom forms and client portals, with ongoing support after launch. I run Clearline Creative in Buckeye and wanted to introduce myself for a possible overflow project.

If a client needs one form connected to their CRM or internal task system, I can scope that handoff around your requirements. The proposed build would include duplicate checks, a visible failure alert, and a sample-data test, with handover notes for your team.

Would it be useful to keep Clearline in mind for a small integration request?

Brian Hill
Clearline Creative
2445 N. Maiden Ct
Buckeye, AZ 85396
Reply no thanks to stop future marketing emails.

subject: Re: New booking request - Randi Martinez, Friday 11 September, 2:00 PM
body:
Hi Randi,

I’m so glad you love it!

The dashboard currently shows the calendar in a list format, but I can add a visual calendar that automatically displays your upcoming appointments while keeping the request list too.

Please send me your exact cancellation and no-show policy. I’ll add a short version to the confirmation email, along with a reminder to arrive 5–10 minutes early.

Marketing emails will be managed through the dashboard once I finish that section. Under U.S. CAN-SPAM rules, prior opt-in generally isn’t required, but every marketing email must provide a clear way to unsubscribe. I still recommend keeping the optional opt-in checkboxjust making it smaller and less prominent—because it creates a cleaner, more engaged mailing list. [FTC guidance](https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/resources/can-spam-act-compliance-guide-business)

Thank you again for the wonderful feedback! And the feedback we have for the work on your account from our CEO, is to ask you to concentrate on business development and not to worry about the site as we
Have that end covered. You need something on the site you don’t see or come up with something all of a
Sudden. just say it. 
We will make it happen :) 

Best,  
Jay

subject: Re: New booking request - Randi Martinez, Friday 11 September, 2:00 PM
body:
Hi Jay!

A calendar would be great if it isn't too much trouble!! I will undoubtedly
struggle if it's only a list.

I've attached a copy of the entire intake form, which includes all
cancellation details at the end.

And if we could make it an opt-out rather than an opt-in, that would be
great. I don't want to get in trouble for sending out emails to clients if
they forget to click opt-in. I'd rather the more cognizant ones click to
opt-out if they choose to not get marketing emails, and then they can be
taken off of the marketing email list. I would prefer this over having them
unsubscribe entirely, as then they would no longer receive appointment
confirmations and reminders in that case. Some clients want the reminders,
but not any extra marketing emails. Currently in MassageBook, on the intake
forms, I have a checkbox they can check to opt-out, and then I go into
their account and toggle that off for them. Then they can still
get appointment confirmations and reminders, which is important. But yeah I
also just don't want clients to *want* emails, but not read the opt-in
checkbox, or to not really think about it at the time. Maybe if you're
really insisting on keeping it as an opt-in, we at least need to say that
they need to opt-in *to hear about deals and promotions* that we have going
on. Otherwise I have no way to tell them when there's a discount or deal or
anything, and I don't want any old ladies getting mad at me for not
informing them. And I don't want them to miss
